topics.name: Clinic Appointment Scheduler
topics.concept: An outpatient clinic booking engine that assigns appointment slots to visit types while respecting provider calendars, room availability, and buffer time between visits. It keeps a per-provider day grid and detects double bookings before they are confirmed. Cancellations free the slot back into the pool automatically.

key_params.providers: number of clinicians on the day grid

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG invents provider names, visit types, and patient request times to fill the day grid.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinic front desks and patient portals to manage outpatient bookings.

topics.name: Waiting Room Wait-Time Tracker
topics.concept: A check-in desk monitor that records arrival, rooming, and provider-entry timestamps for each visit and computes live wait statistics. It flags patients whose wait exceeds a configurable threshold so staff can intervene. End-of-day summaries show average and worst-case waits by hour.

key_params.warn_threshold_min: wait minutes before a flag is raised

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates patient arrivals with realistic morning and afternoon peaks plus service times.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinic managers to spot bottlenecks and report on patient experience metrics.

topics.name: BMI Trend Tracker
topics.concept: A personal health log that stores dated height and weight entries and computes body mass index for each, plotting the trend over time. It classifies each reading into standard adult BMI bands and reports the direction and rate of change. The tool is educational and never gives medical advice.

key_params.height_cm: user height used in the calculation

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates a year of plausible weight entries drifting around a baseline with weekly noise.
topics.real_world_use: Used in wellness apps and health-education programs as a simple self-monitoring example.

topics.name: Blood Pressure Log Analyzer
topics.concept: A home blood-pressure journal that stores systolic, diastolic, and pulse readings with timestamps and computes rolling averages. It groups readings into morning and evening series and highlights readings above configurable alert bands. All thresholds are labeled as informational defaults the user can change.

key_params.alert_systolic: systolic value that triggers an alert band

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG synthesizes twice-daily readings with circadian variation and occasional spikes.
topics.real_world_use: Used by remote patient monitoring pilots and hypertension education tools.

topics.name: Medication Reminder Scheduler
topics.concept: A dosing schedule builder that turns prescriptions into daily reminder times, handling frequencies like twice daily, every 8 hours, or with meals. It detects overlapping doses across medications and produces a printable daily timetable. A missed-dose policy marks how long a dose stays actionable.

key_params.doses: list of medication name, frequency, and start time
key_params.grace_minutes: how long a reminder stays valid

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG invents a synthetic medication list with varied frequencies for the demo schedule.
topics.real_world_use: Used in patient-engagement apps and caregiver tools for adherence support.

topics.name: Vaccination Record Keeper
topics.concept: A synthetic immunization registry that stores vaccine doses with lot numbers and administration dates for fictional patients. It computes which doses in a series are complete and which are due next based on configurable interval rules. The registry exports a printable record card per patient.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates fictional patient records with partial vaccine series at random completion stages.
topics.real_world_use: Used by school health offices and travel clinics in training environments.

topics.name: Immunization Due-Date Calculator
topics.concept: A date engine that applies minimum-interval rules between vaccine doses to compute the earliest date each next dose may be given. It handles multi-dose series with different spacing per dose number and flags doses given too early as invalid. Results are shown as a per-patient due calendar.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG fabricates dose histories for fictional children across several vaccine series.
topics.real_world_use: Used by pediatric scheduling staff to book follow-up vaccine visits at valid intervals.

topics.name: Patient Intake Form Validator
topics.concept: A front-desk data quality gate that checks registration forms for completeness and format: required demographics, phone and email shape, insurance ID patterns, and emergency contact presence. It returns a field-by-field verdict with plain-language fix hints. Nothing is stored beyond the validation session.

key_params.forms: number of synthetic forms to validate

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates synthetic intake forms with a controlled mix of valid and defective entries.
topics.real_world_use: Used by registration teams to catch data-entry errors before they reach the billing system.

topics.name: Consent Form Manager
topics.concept: A document tracker that records which consent forms each synthetic patient has signed, the form version, and the signature date. It flags expired or superseded versions and lists patients missing a required consent before a procedure. Audit entries record every status change.

key_params.validity_days: how long a signature stays valid

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns signed, expired, and missing consents across fictional patients and procedures.
topics.real_world_use: Used by surgical scheduling and research coordinators to keep consent paperwork complete.

topics.name: Interpreter Request Scheduler
topics.concept: A language-services dispatcher that matches interpreter requests to available interpreters by language, modality, and time window. It prioritizes urgent clinical requests and reports unfilled requests per language. The schedule view shows each interpreter's booked blocks.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates appointment requests with language needs spread over a clinic week.
topics.real_world_use: Used by hospital language-access offices to staff interpreters across departments.

topics.name: Patient Transport Dispatcher
topics.concept: A non-emergency transport coordinator that batches ride requests by pickup zone and appointment time, assigning them to vehicles with seat and wheelchair capacity. It builds routes that respect pickup windows and flags requests that cannot be served. Daily manifests list stops in order.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates ride requests with zones, times, and mobility needs for fictional patients.
topics.real_world_use: Used by hospital transport desks coordinating non-emergency medical rides.

topics.name: Hospital Bed Occupancy Simulator
topics.concept: A discrete-event simulation of admissions, transfers, and discharges across nursing units with fixed bed counts. It tracks occupancy, average length of stay, and boarding time for patients waiting on a bed. Managers can test how adding or removing beds changes peak occupancy.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives admissions with daily and weekly seasonality and random lengths of stay.
topics.real_world_use: Used by hospital operations teams for capacity planning and surge exercises.

topics.name: Emergency Triage Queue Simulator
topics.concept: A priority-queue model of an emergency department where arrivals carry an acuity level and are served in acuity order with waiting-time tracking. It reports time-to-provider by acuity band and shows how a surge of low-acuity arrivals affects the wait of high-acuity ones. Staffing levels are adjustable knobs.

key_params.acuity_mix: share of arrivals per acuity level

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG produces arrivals with acuity levels and treatment durations for a simulated shift.
topics.real_world_use: Used in emergency-department staffing studies and operations coursework.

topics.name: Specialist Referral Tracker
topics.concept: A referral lifecycle board that follows each referral from order through scheduling, visit completion, and report return. It ages open referrals and escalates those waiting past a service-level target. Completion-rate reports break down by specialty and ordering provider.

key_params.sla_days: target days from order to completed visit

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates referrals at various lifecycle stages with realistic lag distributions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by primary-care referral coordinators to close the loop on specialist orders.

topics.name: Prior Authorization Tracker
topics.concept: A payer-workflow tracker that records prior authorization requests with procedure codes, submission dates, and status transitions. It predicts which pending requests are at risk of missing the procedure date and summarizes approval and denial rates by payer. Denial reasons are coded for trending.

key_params.sla_days: days before procedure date that triggers a risk flag

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates authorization requests with payer-specific approval odds and turnaround times.
topics.real_world_use: Used by revenue-cycle teams to keep scheduled procedures from slipping on paperwork.

topics.name: Claim Scrubber
topics.concept: A pre-submission claim checker that validates synthetic claim lines against configurable edits: diagnosis-procedure compatibility, required modifiers, and duplicate-line detection. Each claim gets a clean-or-hold verdict with the specific edit codes that fired. Held claims can be corrected and resubmitted in the demo.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds synthetic claims with procedure and diagnosis codes plus a defect injection rate.
topics.real_world_use: Used by billing departments to reduce payer rejections before claims go out.

topics.name: Insurance Eligibility Checker
topics.concept: A batch eligibility verifier that takes a roster of scheduled patients and returns coverage status, plan type, and copay estimates from a synthetic payer database. It flags inactive coverage and mismatched member IDs before the visit date. Results export as a day-of-visit eligibility report.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates a patient roster and a payer master file with matching and mismatched member IDs.
topics.real_world_use: Used by front-office staff running day-before eligibility sweeps.

topics.name: Clinical On-Call Roster Builder
topics.concept: A fair-rotation scheduler that assigns on-call shifts across a clinician pool while honoring blackout dates, max consecutive nights, and specialty coverage rules. It balances total call nights per person and produces a monthly calendar. Swap requests are logged and re-balance the totals.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds a clinician pool with specialties, blackout dates, and seniority weights.
topics.real_world_use: Used by department administrators publishing fair monthly call schedules.

topics.name: Nurse Shift Scheduler
topics.concept: A unit staffing planner that fills shift slots with nurses while respecting contracted hours, rest gaps between shifts, and skill-mix rules per shift. It reports understaffed shifts and overtime risk before the schedule is published. The demo scores schedule fairness across the roster.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates nurse availability, contracted hours, and skill levels for the roster.
topics.real_world_use: Used by nurse managers building equitable unit schedules.

topics.name: Staffing Ratio Calculator
topics.concept: A shift-safety calculator that compares scheduled nurse headcount against patient census to produce nurse-to-patient ratios by unit and shift. It flags ratios worse than configurable targets and estimates the extra staff needed to close the gap. Census can be entered manually or simulated.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates shift census with acuity-driven staffing demand across units.
topics.real_world_use: Used by staffing offices checking shift coverage against ratio targets.

topics.name: Operating Room Schedule Optimizer
topics.concept: A block-schedule packer that sequences surgical cases into OR time blocks, accounting for case duration estimates, turnover time, and surgeon availability. It minimizes idle block time and flags cases likely to run past the block end. The demo compares first-fit and best-fit packing strategies.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates a case list with procedure durations drawn from surgeon-specific distributions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by perioperative services to improve block utilization.

topics.name: Bed Turnover Timer
topics.concept: An environmental-services workflow tracker that timestamps bed-clean requests, assignment, cleaning start, and ready-for-patient events. It computes turnaround time by unit and shift and flags beds waiting past the target. A live board shows every bed in a dirty-to-ready pipeline.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates discharge events and cleaning durations with shift-based crew counts.
topics.real_world_use: Used by EVS supervisors and bed-management teams to speed admissions.

topics.name: Midnight Census Reporter
topics.concept: A daily census compiler that snapshots admissions, discharges, transfers, and deaths from synthetic ADT events into a midnight census per unit. It reconciles the census against bed capacity and produces the standard morning report with occupancy percentages. Variance flags catch units over capacity.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits admission, discharge, and transfer events across units for a multi-week period.
topics.real_world_use: Used by hospital administration for the daily operational census report.

topics.name: Discharge Summary Template Builder
topics.concept: A structured discharge paperwork generator that assembles synthetic discharge summaries from templates: diagnoses, procedures, medication lists, and follow-up plans drawn from a fictional case library. It checks that every required section is present before marking the summary complete. Output is plain text suitable for training review.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG picks diagnoses, procedures, and follow-up items for fictional discharge cases.
topics.real_world_use: Used in clinical documentation training and EHR template design.

topics.name: Care Plan Checklist Engine
topics.concept: A goal-tracking board for synthetic care plans that lists problems, measurable goals, interventions, and review dates per fictional patient. It marks goals met, in progress, or overdue and rolls progress up to a plan-level score. The engine is educational and carries no clinical advice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds care plans with goal statuses distributed across met, in-progress, and overdue.
topics.real_world_use: Used in care-management training and population-health coursework.

topics.name: Chronic Care Registry
topics.concept: A population registry for fictional patients with chronic conditions that tracks last visit, key lab values, and care-gap flags like overdue screenings. It stratifies patients into risk tiers and lists outreach candidates per tier. All patients and values are synthetic.

key_params.gap_rules: what counts as a care gap

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates patient panels with visit dates, lab values, and condition lists.
topics.real_world_use: Used by population-health teams to find care gaps in training datasets.

topics.name: Population Health Dashboard
topics.concept: An aggregate analytics board over a synthetic patient population: condition prevalence, screening completion rates, and utilization trends by segment. It refreshes from a simulated data feed and highlights segments drifting off target. No individual-level data is displayed.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits aggregate metric snapshots with seasonal drift for each segment.
topics.real_world_use: Used by health-system strategy teams exploring population analytics patterns.

topics.name: Readmission Risk Scorer (Synthetic Demo)
topics.concept: A transparent scoring demo that combines synthetic risk factors like prior admissions, length of stay, and comorbidity counts into a readmission risk score with an explained breakdown. It is a teaching model with invented weights, clearly labeled as not for clinical use. Score distributions can be compared across synthetic cohorts.

key_params.weights: factor weights in the demo model

topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates fictional discharge records with risk-factor values and synthetic outcomes.
topics.real_world_use: Used in health-data-science courses to teach risk-score construction and calibration.

topics.name: Appointment No-Show Predictor (Synthetic Demo)
topics.concept: A teaching classifier that predicts no-show probability from synthetic features like lead time, prior no-shows, and time of day, using a simple decision tree trained on invented data. It reports feature importance and accuracy on a held-out synthetic split. Labeled as a classroom demo, not a production model.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates appointment histories with a known no-show generating process.
topics.real_world_use: Used in healthcare analytics courses to demonstrate classification on tabular data.

topics.name: Lab Result Tracker
topics.concept: A result-management queue that logs synthetic lab orders, expected turnaround times, and result values against reference ranges. It escalates critical values immediately and overdue results past their expected time. A daily digest lists pending, resulted, and critical counts.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates lab orders with result values, some critical and some overdue.
topics.real_world_use: Used by lab managers and in informatics training for result-communication workflows.

topics.name: Radiology Order Tracker
topics.concept: An imaging workflow board that follows synthetic orders from placement through scheduling, completion, and final report signing. It measures order-to-report turnaround by modality and flags studies waiting past target. Contrast and prep requirements are tracked per order.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates imaging orders with modality-specific durations and prep needs.
topics.real_world_use: Used by radiology operations to monitor report turnaround in training scenarios.

topics.name: Telehealth Session Scheduler
topics.concept: A virtual-visit planner that books video sessions across provider availability and patient time zones, attaching meeting links and pre-visit checklist items. It prevents double booking and sends synthetic reminder events at configurable lead times. Time-zone conversion is handled explicitly.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates visit requests across time zones with provider availability windows.
topics.real_world_use: Used by virtual-care programs coordinating multi-time-zone scheduling.

topics.name: FHIR-like Record Simulator
topics.concept: A synthetic clinical record generator that emits patient, encounter, observation, and medication resources in a FHIR-shaped JSON structure with invented identifiers. It validates resources against a small local schema and serves them from an in-memory store with search by patient. Every record is fictional and clearly watermarked synthetic.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds patient demographics, encounters, observations, and medication lists.
topics.real_world_use: Used by health-IT developers learning FHIR resource shapes without touching real data.

topics.name: HL7 Message Simulator
topics.concept: A teaching parser for synthetic HL7v2-style pipe-delimited messages covering admissions, orders, and results. It parses segments into fields, validates required segments per message type, and reports structural errors with line numbers. Messages are invented for the demo and carry no real patient data.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assembles HL7-shaped messages with controlled structural defects for parser testing.
topics.real_world_use: Used in interface-engine training to teach HL7 message structure and validation.

topics.name: Clinical Text De-identifier
topics.concept: A safe-harbor style scrubber that replaces names, dates, locations, and contact details in synthetic clinical notes with realistic surrogates. It reports what was replaced per category and keeps a consistent surrogate mapping within a document set. Input notes are fictional and generated for the demo.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG writes fictional clinical notes seeded with invented identifiers to scrub.
topics.real_world_use: Used in research-data preparation training for de-identification concepts.

topics.name: Synthetic Patient Population Generator
topics.concept: A demographic and clinical profile generator that creates internally consistent fictional patients: age, sex, conditions, medications, and visit histories with plausible correlations. It exports the population as CSV or JSON for downstream demos. A fixed seed reproduces the same population exactly.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG with a fixed default seed builds correlated demographic and clinical attributes.
topics.real_world_use: Used across health-IT demos and classrooms as a stand-in for real patient data.

topics.name: Access Audit Logger
topics.concept: An access-event ledger that records who viewed which synthetic record, when, and for what stated purpose, in an append-only log. It detects anomalous patterns like bulk access outside business hours and produces auditor-ready summaries. Log integrity is protected with per-entry checksums.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG emits access events with a small injected anomaly rate for detection demos.
topics.real_world_use: Used by compliance teams demonstrating audit-trail concepts in training.

topics.name: Patient Safety Incident Logger
topics.concept: A safety-event reporting intake that captures synthetic incident reports with category, severity, location, and contributing factors from a controlled vocabulary. It routes high-severity events for review and trends event counts by category over time. All incidents are fictional training cases.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates incident reports with category and severity distributions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by patient-safety teams training staff on event reporting and trending.

topics.name: Patient Satisfaction Survey Analyzer
topics.concept: A survey analytics tool that ingests synthetic patient-experience responses, scores domains like communication and cleanliness, and computes top-box percentages. It surfaces the lowest-scoring questions per unit and tracks trends across survey waves. Comment text is fictional and analyzed for keyword themes.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates Likert responses with unit-level biases and fictional comments.
topics.real_world_use: Used by patient-experience teams practicing survey analytics on synthetic data.

topics.name: Pharmacy Inventory Tracker
topics.concept: A medication stock manager for a synthetic formulary that tracks on-hand quantities, reorder points, and expiration dates by drug and storage location. It raises reorder and expiring-soon alerts and values inventory at unit cost. Controlled-substance counts get a separate audit report.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates dispensing events that draw down stock with seasonal demand.
topics.real_world_use: Used by pharmacy operations training for inventory and expiration management.

topics.name: Vaccine Cold-Chain Monitor
topics.concept: A temperature telemetry simulator for vaccine refrigerators that streams synthetic sensor readings and alarms on excursions outside the safe band. It computes mean kinetic temperature over the window and logs door-open events. Excursion reports list affected lots for the demo.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG streams temperature readings with compressor cycles and injected excursion events.
topics.real_world_use: Used by immunization programs training staff on cold-chain monitoring.

topics.name: EHR Downtime Procedure Checklist
topics.concept: A downtime operations runner that walks staff through paper-backup procedures during a simulated EHR outage: registration, ordering, and documentation on downtime forms. It tracks which steps are complete per unit and times how long each takes. A recovery checklist guides re-entry when the system returns.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns step completion times and occasional missed steps across units.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinical informatics teams running downtime drills.

topics.name: Clinical Document Organizer
topics.concept: A file organizer that sorts scanned clinical documents into a folder tree by document type, synthetic patient ID, and date, renaming files to a standard convention. It flags unreadable or duplicate scans for review. A manifest records every move for audit.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates dummy scan files with varied names, types, and some duplicates.
topics.real_world_use: Used by health-information-management teams in scanning-workflow training.

topics.name: Medical Coding Practice Quiz
topics.concept: A quiz engine that drills synthetic coding scenarios: a short fictional case vignette followed by multiple-choice code options from a demo code set. It explains each answer, tracks accuracy by category, and adapts difficulty based on recent performance. All cases are invented for practice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assembles vignettes from fictional diagnoses, procedures, and code options.
topics.real_world_use: Used by coding students preparing for certification exams.

topics.name: Medical Terminology Flashcards
topics.concept: A spaced-repetition flashcard deck for medical roots, prefixes, and suffixes with definitions written from scratch for the demo. It schedules reviews using a simple Leitner box system and tracks mastery per term. Sessions are short by design with daily review targets.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG shuffles an original term list and simulates review outcomes.
topics.real_world_use: Used by health-science students building vocabulary.

topics.name: Provider Directory Service
topics.concept: A searchable directory of synthetic providers with specialty, location, languages, and accepting-new-patients status. It supports filters by specialty and distance band and returns a formatted provider card. The directory refreshes from a generated roster on a schedule.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds provider profiles with specialties, locations, and languages.
topics.real_world_use: Used by patient-access teams demonstrating directory search in portals.

topics.name: Appointment Reminder Engine
topics.concept: A reminder dispatcher that sends synthetic notifications at configurable lead times before appointments and records confirmations, cancellations, and no-responses. It computes confirmation rates by lead time and message channel. Quiet hours are respected per patient time zone.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates appointments with patient response behaviors per channel.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinics reducing no-shows through automated reminders.

topics.name: Referral Leakage Analyzer (Synthetic)
topics.concept: An analytics demo that measures what share of synthetic referrals stay in-network versus going elsewhere, broken down by specialty and ordering provider. It estimates the associated visit volume and flags the largest leakage sources. All providers and patients are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates referrals with destination choices influenced by synthetic distance and wait.
topics.real_world_use: Used by health-system strategy teams learning network-integrity analytics.

topics.name: Claim Denial Management Tracker
topics.concept: A denial worklist that ingests synthetic denied claims with reason codes, routes them to follow-up queues by reason, and tracks appeal outcomes and recovered amounts. It trends denial rates by reason and payer to guide prevention work. All claims and dollars are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates denied claims with reason codes and appeal timelines.
topics.real_world_use: Used by revenue-cycle teams practicing denial prevention analytics.

topics.name: Charge Capture Auditor
topics.concept: A reconciliation demo that compares synthetic procedure logs against billed charges to find missing or mismatched charges. It scores each encounter for capture completeness and lists the top missing-charge patterns. Findings export as an audit worklist.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG pairs procedure logs with charge records, injecting omissions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by revenue-integrity teams demonstrating charge reconciliation.

topics.name: Price Transparency Estimator
topics.concept: A patient-facing estimate tool that combines a synthetic chargemaster with plan benefit rules to produce good-faith cost estimates for common procedures. It shows the facility fee, professional fee, and estimated patient responsibility side by side. Estimates are labeled as educational approximations.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds a chargemaster and benefit rules for fictional facilities and plans.
topics.real_world_use: Used by patient-financial-services teams demonstrating price transparency.

topics.name: Provider Credentialing Tracker
topics.concept: A credential lifecycle manager that tracks synthetic provider licenses, board certifications, and privileging with expiration dates. It sends renewal reminders at configurable lead times and flags lapsed credentials blocking scheduling. A compliance dashboard shows percent current by department.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns credentials with staggered expirations and renewal lags.
topics.real_world_use: Used by medical-staff offices managing credentialing workflows.

topics.name: Clinical Peer Review Tracker
topics.concept: A case-review workflow for synthetic quality reviews: cases are assigned to reviewers, scored against criteria, and summarized for committee discussion. It tracks review turnaround and score distributions while keeping reviewer identities separate from case lists in the demo. All cases are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates review cases with findings and reviewer score patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by quality departments demonstrating peer-review administration.

topics.name: Hand Hygiene Audit Tool
topics.concept: An observational audit collector for synthetic hand-hygiene observations across units, recording opportunities and compliant actions by role and moment. It computes compliance rates with confidence intervals and trends them by unit over audit periods. Data entry works offline-first in the demo.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates observations with unit-level compliance differences.
topics.real_world_use: Used by infection-prevention teams training auditors on data collection.

topics.name: Antibiotic Stewardship Tracker
topics.concept: A prescribing-pattern monitor over synthetic antibiotic orders that flags broad-spectrum use, prolonged durations, and missing de-escalation reviews. It computes days-of-therapy per thousand patient-days by unit. Prescriber feedback reports are anonymized in the demo.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates antibiotic orders with durations and de-escalation behaviors.
topics.real_world_use: Used by stewardship programs demonstrating prescribing analytics.

topics.name: Fall Risk Rounds Planner
topics.concept: A rounding scheduler that prioritizes synthetic patients by fall-risk score for hourly safety rounds, balancing high-risk coverage with staff workload. It logs completed rounds and missed checks, and reports coverage of high-risk patients per shift. Risk factors are synthetic and educational.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns fall-risk scores and generates round completion events.
topics.real_world_use: Used by nursing quality teams demonstrating risk-based rounding.

topics.name: Pressure Injury Tracker
topics.concept: A skin-integrity surveillance log for synthetic patients that records risk assessments, prevention interventions, and any injury events with staging. It computes unit-level injury rates and intervention compliance. All patients and events are fictional training data.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates assessments, interventions, and rare injury events.
topics.real_world_use: Used by wound-care teams practicing surveillance analytics.

topics.name: Sepsis Screening Drill
topics.concept: A training simulator that streams synthetic vital-sign sets and asks the learner to apply screening criteria, scoring their sensitivity against the hidden labels. It explains each miss with the criteria that were met. Vital signs are invented for education and the tool gives no clinical advice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG produces vital-sign trajectories, some meeting screening criteria.
topics.real_world_use: Used in nursing education for early-recognition drills.

topics.name: Rapid Response Event Logger
topics.concept: An event log for synthetic rapid-response activations capturing triggers, response times, interventions, and outcomes. It trends activations by unit and trigger type and computes median response time. Cases are fictional and used for quality review training.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates activation events with response-time distributions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by rapid-response committees reviewing system performance.

topics.name: Code Drill Performance Tracker
topics.concept: A mock-code debrief tool that times synthetic resuscitation drill milestones like first compression and first defibrillation against targets. It scores team performance per drill and tracks improvement across drill series. All drills are simulated training events.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates milestone times with team-level learning curves.
topics.real_world_use: Used by resuscitation committees running mock-code programs.

topics.name: Emergency Patient Flow Board
topics.concept: A live-status board simulator for an emergency department showing each synthetic patient in arrival, triage, treatment, or boarding stages with elapsed times. It highlights stage waits past targets and computes overall length of stay. The board refreshes on a configurable tick.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG moves synthetic patients through stages with stage-time distributions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by ED leadership for flow-visibility demos and training.

topics.name: Discharge Lounge Scheduler
topics.concept: A throughput optimizer that schedules discharged synthetic patients into lounge seats while they await rides or prescriptions, freeing inpatient beds sooner. It matches lounge capacity to discharge waves and reports bed-hours saved. The demo compares lounge versus no-lounge flow.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates discharge times clustered in afternoon waves.
topics.real_world_use: Used by patient-flow teams evaluating discharge-lounge programs.

topics.name: Language Services Usage Analyzer
topics.concept: A utilization report over synthetic interpreter encounters by language, modality, and department with cost estimates per encounter type. It identifies under-served languages and peak demand windows. All encounters are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates interpreter encounters with language and duration patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by language-access programs justifying staffing levels.

topics.name: Hospital Visitor Management Log
topics.concept: A front-desk visitor register for synthetic guests with host department, badge issuance, and check-in/check-out times. It enforces visitor policy rules like per-patient limits and produces a who-is-in-the-building report for emergencies. Data is fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates visitor arrivals tied to synthetic patient stays.
topics.real_world_use: Used by facilities teams demonstrating visitor tracking.

topics.name: Medical Equipment Tracking Board
topics.concept: An asset-location board for synthetic mobile equipment like infusion pumps and wheelchairs, tracking which unit holds each item and its clean or dirty status. It flags units hoarding equipment and lists items due for preventive maintenance. All assets are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG moves equipment between units with usage and cleaning cycles.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinical engineering demonstrating asset-tracking workflows.

topics.name: Facilities Work-Order Queue
topics.concept: A hospital facilities ticket system for synthetic work orders with priority, trade, location, and SLA targets. It ages open tickets, escalates SLA breaches, and reports completion rates by trade. Technicians are fictional staff.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates work orders with priorities and completion-time distributions.
topics.real_world_use: Used by facilities management training on work-order triage.

topics.name: Linen Usage Tracker
topics.concept: A laundry-demand model for synthetic linen consumption by unit, tracking par levels and daily usage against deliveries. It forecasts next-day demand from census and flags units below par. The demo tunes par levels to avoid both stockouts and overstock.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates daily linen use tied to census and turnover.
topics.real_world_use: Used by materials management optimizing linen par levels.

topics.name: Dietary Order Manager
topics.concept: A meal-service coordinator for synthetic patients that maps diet orders to menu choices, tracks allergies and restrictions, and builds tray tickets per meal service. It flags diet-order conflicts and reports diet-type counts for the kitchen. All patients and allergies are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns diet orders, allergies, and meal selections.
topics.real_world_use: Used by food-and-nutrition services demonstrating tray-line workflows.

topics.name: Pharmacy Rounds Checklist
topics.concept: A clinical rounding aid that walks a synthetic pharmacist through per-patient review items: renal dosing, interactions, duplicate therapy, and allergy checks against a fictional medication list. It scores review completeness and lists flagged items for follow-up. Educational, with invented drug data.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds patient medication lists with injected review findings.
topics.real_world_use: Used in pharmacy education for systematic medication review.

topics.name: Dosage Calculator (Educational)
topics.concept: A weight-based dose calculator for training that computes doses from mg-per-kg orders, converts units, and checks the result against a configurable maximum. It shows every arithmetic step so learners can verify the math. Labeled strictly educational with fictional drug examples.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates practice problems with weights and ordered doses.
topics.real_world_use: Used in nursing and pharmacy math education.

topics.name: IV Drip Rate Trainer
topics.concept: An infusion-math drill that computes drip rates in drops per minute and mL per hour from volume, time, and drop-factor inputs, with step-by-step solutions. It generates practice problems at graduated difficulty and tracks learner accuracy. Fictional scenarios only.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates infusion scenarios with volumes, times, and drop factors.
topics.real_world_use: Used in nursing education for dosage-calculation practice.

topics.name: Pediatric Growth Chart Plotter (Educational)
topics.concept: A growth-tracking visualizer that plots synthetic child measurements against simplified percentile bands drawn for the demo, computing z-score style deviations from the band midpoints. It flags crossings of major percentile lines as discussion points for training. Not a clinical growth standard.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates growth trajectories, some crossing percentile bands.
topics.real_world_use: Used in pediatric training to teach growth-chart interpretation.

topics.name: Preventive Screening Recall System
topics.concept: A recall engine that scans a synthetic patient registry for overdue preventive screenings based on age and interval rules, then builds outreach lists by screening type. It tracks outreach attempts and completion, computing recall effectiveness. All patients are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates patient ages and last-screening dates with completion behaviors.
topics.real_world_use: Used by primary-care teams demonstrating population outreach.

topics.name: Care Gap Closure Tracker
topics.concept: A quality-measure dashboard over synthetic data that tracks open and closed care gaps per measure, provider, and month. It attributes closures to outreach, visits, or data correction and projects year-end closure rates. Measures use simplified demo definitions.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates gap opens and closures with provider-level variation.
topics.real_world_use: Used by quality teams learning gap-closure analytics.

topics.name: Telehealth Visit Analyzer (Synthetic)
topics.concept: A visit-pattern analysis over synthetic telehealth encounters: visit reasons, durations, no-show rates, and technical-issue flags by specialty. It compares telehealth versus in-person mix and reports after-hours volume. All encounters are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates encounters with durations, outcomes, and tech flags.
topics.real_world_use: Used by virtual-care programs exploring utilization analytics.

topics.name: Specialty Wait-Time Benchmark
topics.concept: A benchmarking demo that computes third-next-available appointment waits per specialty from synthetic schedules and compares them against access targets. It ranks specialties by access and simulates how added template slots change the ranking. Schedules are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds slot templates with booked and open slots per specialty.
topics.real_world_use: Used by access-management teams studying appointment availability.

topics.name: Clinic Throughput Model
topics.concept: A session model that estimates how many patients a clinic template can serve given visit lengths, no-show rates, and room constraints. It tests template changes like longer slots or added rooms and reports patients served and overtime risk. Inputs are synthetic.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates clinic sessions with service-time and no-show randomness.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinic managers right-sizing appointment templates.

topics.name: Surgery Schedule Board
topics.concept: A day-of-surgery status board for synthetic cases showing patient readiness milestones: consent signed, site marked, anesthesia ready, and wheels-in time. It flags cases at risk of delay and computes on-time start rates by surgeon. All cases are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates cases with milestone completion times.
topics.real_world_use: Used by perioperative teams demonstrating day-of-surgery coordination.

topics.name: Anesthesia Drug Log (Training)
topics.concept: A training log that records synthetic anesthesia medication administrations with dose, route, and time for fictional cases. It checks doses against weight-based demo ranges and flags out-of-range entries for instructor review. Clearly labeled as a training simulation.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates case drug administrations with occasional out-of-range doses.
topics.real_world_use: Used in anesthesia training for documentation practice.

topics.name: Blood Bank Inventory Simulator
topics.concept: A blood-product inventory model tracking synthetic units by blood type with shelf lives, daily demand, and wastage from expiration. It sets reorder points per type and simulates emergency release events. All units and patients are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG drives transfusions with type-specific demand and rare massive-transfusion events.
topics.real_world_use: Used by transfusion services training on inventory management.

topics.name: Organ Waitlist Model (Educational)
topics.concept: A simplified allocation teaching model that ranks synthetic waitlist candidates by a transparent demo score combining waiting time, medical urgency inputs, and compatibility factors. It simulates match runs when fictional donor organs arrive. Labeled as a simplified educational model of a complex real process.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates candidates with wait times, urgency inputs, and compatibility profiles.
topics.real_world_use: Used in health-policy education to teach allocation concepts.

topics.name: Dialysis Schedule Planner
topics.concept: A chair-scheduling tool for synthetic dialysis patients across shifts, chairs, and isolation needs, respecting treatment durations and nurse ratios. It balances chair utilization and flags unaccommodated patients. All patients are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates patients with shift preferences, durations, and isolation flags.
topics.real_world_use: Used by dialysis centers demonstrating chair scheduling.

topics.name: Infusion Center Scheduler
topics.concept: A chair-and-nurse scheduler for synthetic infusion appointments with drug-specific durations and monitoring levels. It sequences appointments to smooth nurse workload and minimize chair idle time. Reactions are simulated as rare events for the demo.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates appointments with durations and acuity-driven nurse assignments.
topics.real_world_use: Used by infusion centers optimizing chair turnover.

topics.name: Home Health Visit Router
topics.concept: A route planner for synthetic home-health visits that sequences patient stops by geography, visit duration, and time windows, assigning them to clinicians by skill. It minimizes drive time while honoring visit priorities. Addresses are fictional map points.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG places fictional patient addresses on a grid with visit windows.
topics.real_world_use: Used by home-health agencies demonstrating route optimization.

topics.name: Hospice Census Tracker (Synthetic)
topics.concept: A census and visit tracker for a fictional hospice program: admissions, discharges, average daily census, and visit counts by discipline. It projects census trends and staffing needs from admission patterns. All data is synthetic.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates admissions, lengths of stay, and visit completions.
topics.real_world_use: Used in hospice administration training for census analytics.

topics.name: Behavioral Health Scheduler
topics.concept: An appointment book for synthetic behavioral-health services handling intake assessments, therapy sessions, and group slots with provider specialty matching. It tracks waitlists for intake and reports time-to-first-appointment. All clients are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates service requests with acuity and modality preferences.
topics.real_world_use: Used by behavioral-health programs demonstrating access management.

topics.name: Dental Claims Tracker
topics.concept: A dental billing demo that tracks synthetic claims by procedure category, submitted amounts, and payer responses. It computes collection rates and average reimbursement per category and flags frequently denied codes. All claims are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates claims with category-specific denial odds.
topics.real_world_use: Used by dental practice managers learning claims analytics.

topics.name: Vision Benefits Checker
topics.concept: An eligibility demo for synthetic vision plans that returns exam and eyewear benefits, copays, and frequency limits per member. It computes patient responsibility for a sample eyewear order. Members and plans are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds members, plan rules, and eyewear orders.
topics.real_world_use: Used by optical shops demonstrating benefits verification.

topics.name: Workplace Wellness Challenge Tracker
topics.concept: A team step-challenge scorer for synthetic participants that aggregates daily step counts into team totals, computes leaderboards, and awards streak badges. It handles late data entry and prorates partial weeks. All participants are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates daily steps with weekday and weekend patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by corporate wellness programs running step challenges.

topics.name: Health Risk Assessment Scorer (Educational)
topics.concept: A lifestyle questionnaire scorer for training that converts synthetic answers about activity, nutrition, sleep, and tobacco into domain scores and an overall wellness index. It generates a plain-language feedback report with no medical advice. All respondents are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates questionnaire responses with correlated lifestyle patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by wellness vendors demonstrating HRA reporting.

topics.name: Biometric Screening Event Log
topics.concept: An event manager for synthetic workplace screening events: station throughput, measured values, and participant flow from check-in to exit. It computes average station times and identifies the bottleneck station. All participants and values are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates participant flow through stations with service times.
topics.real_world_use: Used by wellness vendors planning screening events.

topics.name: Flu Clinic Planner
topics.concept: A mass-vaccination throughput planner that sizes stations, staff, and vaccine supply for a synthetic flu clinic from expected turnout. It simulates queueing at registration, screening, vaccination, and observation to find the bottleneck. All numbers are fictional planning inputs.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG models arrivals in waves with per-stage service times.
topics.real_world_use: Used by occupational health teams planning vaccination events.

topics.name: Travel Vaccine Planner (Educational)
topics.concept: A trip-based vaccine checklist builder for education that maps fictional itineraries to recommended vaccine considerations from a demo rule set, with timing guidance before departure. It produces a printable pre-travel checklist. Labeled educational with simplified demo rules.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates itineraries with destinations, durations, and traveler ages.
topics.real_world_use: Used by travel clinics demonstrating pre-travel planning.

topics.name: School Health Office Log
topics.concept: A visit log for a synthetic school health office recording student visits by complaint category, disposition, and time out of class. It trends visit reasons by month and flags students with frequent visits for counselor review. All students are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates visits with seasonal illness patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by school nurses demonstrating visit documentation and trending.

topics.name: Sports Physical Tracker
topics.concept: A clearance tracker for synthetic student athletes recording physical exam dates, clearance status, and expiration per sport season. It lists athletes with expiring or missing clearances before tryouts. All athletes are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns exam dates and clearance outcomes across rosters.
topics.real_world_use: Used by school athletic departments managing physical paperwork.

topics.name: Nutrition Label Analyzer (Educational)
topics.concept: A label-reading trainer that parses synthetic nutrition facts panels, computes percent daily values, and flags high sodium, added sugars, and saturated fat per serving. It compares two products side by side for a healthier-choice exercise. Labels are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds nutrition panels with realistic nutrient correlations.
topics.real_world_use: Used in nutrition education for label-literacy exercises.

topics.name: Meal Plan Builder (Educational)
topics.concept: A weekly meal planner for education that assembles synthetic meals meeting calorie and macronutrient targets from a fictional food database. It balances variety across the week and produces a shopping list. Labeled educational with no medical nutrition advice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG draws meals from a fictional food database with macro values.
topics.real_world_use: Used in nutrition courses demonstrating meal-planning logic.

topics.name: Sleep Diary Analyzer
topics.concept: A sleep-journal tool that takes synthetic bedtimes, wake times, and quality ratings and computes sleep duration, efficiency, and weekly averages. It charts the sleep schedule and flags irregular patterns. All entries are fictional and the tool gives no medical advice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates sleep entries with weekday and weekend differences.
topics.real_world_use: Used in sleep-hygiene education and wellness programs.

topics.name: Fitness Goal Tracker
topics.concept: A workout-goal monitor for synthetic training logs that tracks progress toward weekly targets for sessions, minutes, or distance. It computes streaks, completion rates, and projected goal dates. All athletes and workouts are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates workouts with adherence patterns and rest days.
topics.real_world_use: Used by fitness apps demonstrating goal-tracking features.

topics.name: Hydration Reminder Log
topics.concept: A water-intake logger for education that records synthetic drink entries against a daily target, sending reminders at configurable intervals. It charts intake by hour and computes streak days meeting the goal. All data is fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates drink entries clustered around meals and workouts.
topics.real_world_use: Used in wellness apps as a simple habit-tracking example.

topics.name: Posture Break Timer
topics.concept: A desk-health timer that schedules micro-breaks through the workday, logs completed stretch breaks, and reports adherence by day and week. Break routines rotate from a demo exercise list. It is a wellness reminder, not medical guidance.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG simulates break completions with meeting-driven skips.
topics.real_world_use: Used in workplace wellness programs for break reminders.

topics.name: Drug Interaction Checker Demo (Educational)
topics.concept: An educational interaction demo over a fictional drug database that flags pair, triple, and food interactions with severity levels and plain-language explanations. It demonstrates how interaction severity is graded without using real drug data. Labeled strictly educational.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG builds a fictional drug list and interaction pairs with severity grades.
topics.real_world_use: Used in pharmacy education to teach interaction-checking concepts.

topics.name: Allergy Alert Card Generator
topics.concept: A wallet-card generator for fictional patients that lists allergies, reaction types, and severity on a printable card with emergency instructions. It validates that reaction descriptions use the controlled demo vocabulary. All patients are synthetic.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns allergies and reaction severities to fictional patients.
topics.real_world_use: Used in patient-education materials demonstrating allergy documentation.

topics.name: Advance Directive Registry (Demo)
topics.concept: A document registry demo tracking synthetic advance directives with type, execution date, witness status, and surrogate contacts. It flags documents needing review after major health events in the fictional timeline. All persons are fictional and the tool gives no legal advice.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates directive records with execution dates and surrogate contacts.
topics.real_world_use: Used in advance-care-planning education.

topics.name: Patient Portal Simulator
topics.concept: A mock patient portal with synthetic accounts offering appointment lists, test-result views, messaging, and bill-pay demos. It demonstrates portal navigation and feature layout with entirely fictional data. Useful as a UI and API design reference.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG populates accounts with appointments, results, and messages.
topics.real_world_use: Used by health-IT teams prototyping portal features.

topics.name: Provider Inbox Queue Simulator
topics.concept: A clinical inbox simulator routing synthetic patient messages to pools by message type with response-time targets. It prioritizes urgent messages, measures time-to-response, and reports inbox backlog by pool. All messages are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG generates messages with types, urgency, and arrival patterns.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinics designing inbox management workflows.

topics.name: Test Result Release Timer
topics.concept: A result-embargo simulator that holds synthetic test results for a configurable review window before patient-portal release, with immediate release for critical values. It logs release times and computes embargo compliance. Results are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG creates results with critical flags and provider review delays.
topics.real_world_use: Used by informatics teams demonstrating results-release policies.

topics.name: Preventive Recall Engine
topics.concept: A recall campaign tool that identifies synthetic patients due for annual visits or follow-ups, builds outreach batches, and tracks booking conversion per batch. It staggers batches to match scheduling capacity. All patients are fictional.
topics.data_idea: A seeded RNG assigns due dates and booking responses to fictional patients.
topics.real_world_use: Used by clinics running recall campaigns for annual visits.
